note: The top-level (rule (width 400.0)) replaces the default NetGroup width (203.2 before). (clear 152.6) sets the spacing of every Kind pair; (clear 38.2 (type smd_smd)) then sets smd/smd. The file also carries typed clearances whose Kind pairs are written as bare_name_"quoted name" (underscore-joined with a quoted second name); both references accept the file without error but the Kinds those lines create are not meaningful and are left unspecified.
